name: ai-heavy-rewrite
prompt: Humanize this. It's the opening of a product one-pager for our onboarding platform. Keep it professional.
expectations: The response contains a full rewritten text and a change summary, not just a list of findings
The change summary names at least three patterns using the skill's stable IDs (for example INFLATION, NEG-PARALLEL, BOLD-LISTS, GENERIC-CLOSER, DIDACTIC, VAGUE-ATTRIB, AI-VOCAB)
The rewritten text contains no negative parallelism: no 'not just X, it's Y', 'more than just', or 'not only X but Y' construction
The rewritten text contains no generic positive closer such as 'the road ahead is promising' or 'the future looks bright', and does not end on an equivalent vague upbeat sentence
The vague attribution 'Industry reports indicate' is either removed or replaced with a specific named source, or is explicitly flagged as needing a real citation; it is not kept as-is
The bold inline-header list (Speed/Clarity/Confidence) is converted to prose or a plain list without bolded lead-ins followed by colons

The rewritten text introduces no new AI-vocabulary words (delve, robust, leverage, seamless, tapestry, landscape as abstract noun) that were not already present, and reads as professional register rather than casual first-person
